completion_criteria.text: U1-U7 experiments run and recorded in a companion findings doc; each claim marked verified or refuted with evidence, before any step that depends on it
Step 0 shipped: protect-claude-config.sh narrowed to the gate implementation and deny list only, ask converted to deny, confirmed live
Promotion manifest hardened first: hooks and permissions.deny reclassified so absence refuses promotion rather than deleting from live, and undeclared keys are refused instead of freezing
Delivery path proven without the sandbox: an agent pushes a branch and opens a PR through the centralized pr-create tool with no human hands
Layer 1 made operational: the two PreToolUse hooks registered in tracked settings and promoted to the live install, so checkpointing and rm-to-trash can fire at all
Install topology returned to direct repo symlinks: the ten ~/.claude entries point straight at the repo, and releases/, current, LIVE and local/ are removed
Deny pruned to genuine catastrophes per 0409 and every ask rule retired: entries that are speed bumps or routing preferences removed, user-affirmed gates and secret guards kept
Allow widened per 0408 so ordinary work never prompts: broad tool-level allow plus mcp__* coverage, and settings.local.json truncated so one-off rules stop accumulating at source
Layer 1 shipped whole: per-worktree temp-index checkpoint using --force, rm-to-trash rewrite, hourly APFS snapshot, and the D2 age-based reaper in the same change
Layer 3 shipped: one PreToolUse gate, P0-P6 in order, allow/block only, fail-open except P1/P2/P5, honoring the D3 local-container carve-out
Layer 4 shipped: append-only tool-call audit log plus a SessionStart heartbeat asserting layers 0 and 1 and the promotion pointer
Layer 0 shipped: sandbox with allowLocalBinding, allowUnsandboxedCommands false and failIfUnavailable true, keeping filesystem containment with working localhost
Steps 8-9 shipped: inert and harmful hooks deleted; logbook plugin fail-closed guard disabled or patched (R6)
R3 rule change landed: the standing --dangerously-skip-permissions prohibition replaced by a rule requiring layers 0, 1 and 4 live first
Release path closed: a staleness heartbeat reports when local main is behind the remote without applying, and a verify verb asserts installed machinery matches its tracked source
Governed unattended launcher: a version-controlled script is the sole entry point, hardcodes the permission mode, and passes through no caller settings, closing the inline-JSON argv channel
One PR per MSP opened through the centralized pr-create tool, each leaving its base branch green

spine.active_goal: Permissions only: deny is pruned to genuine catastrophes; what remains is widening allow so ordinary work never prompts, then the PR.
spine.next_step: c4 next: widen allow per 0408 (broad tool-level allow plus mcp__* coverage) and truncate settings.local.json, applying every edit to BOTH .claude/settings.json and ~/.claude/settings.json since no propagation path remains. Then c9 (gate dead tokens, 0398-gated; nested settings.local.json) and c11 (the PR). Separately worth doing: close the default-branch push hole, which is widening not pruning so it stayed out of c3.
spine.last_session: Struck c14 as unenforceable ceremony (0411) and shipped c3: deny pruned 47 to 36 in both the tracked and live settings.json, committed as 15d8dca. Verified deny survives bypassPermissions, that the gate does not blanket-block curl, and that ssh commit signing works.

open_risks.text: Prune the gate tokens that guard the deleted release tree — guardname still lists releases, current, local, LIVE, CUTOVER and .cutover, which now match nothing, and 0398 gates the change on direct user confirmation
Delete the nested ~/.claude/.claude/settings.local.json — it still allows protect-claude-config.sh, deleted in c8a1b9a, from a path Claude Code does not read as a settings surface
Do not strip the merge gates — gh pr merge and merge_pull_request stay denied by deliberate user choice, and pr-create centralization stays too

Default-branch push denies are prefix-literal and the gate has no push clause at all — git push -u origin main, git push origin HEAD:main and a bare git push with upstream set all reach main untouched, so 0405 is thinner than it reads
The tracked and live settings.json are two independent real files with no propagation path left after the installer was deleted — every permission edit must be applied to both by hand or it is inert
Spawning a subagent can still destroy the promoted entries — the cause is unidentified, but recovery is now one ln -sfn loop because they are plain symlinks rather than copied trees
gpg.ssh.allowedSignersFile is unset, so git log --show-signature errors and reports No signature on commits that ARE signed — read the raw gpgsig header before concluding a commit is unsigned
Fix or retire scripts/install_config.sh before anyone runs it by reflex — running it would undo c17 and move the live global settings.json into a backup dir, replacing it with a repo symlink
Run the full suite at the merge boundary, not just per-branch — three PRs each genuinely green alone reddened the base once composed

key_decisions.title: Default-branch push denies stay, reclassified as delivery contract not catastrophe
Oversight-reducing changes wait for direct user confirmation
main is published only through a pull request, never a direct push
The containment architecture is removed; autonomy is a permissions problem only
A deny entry is removed when it guards no catastrophe; no replacement is required
Allow is broad by default; deny is the only narrow list
The ten entries are installed as explicit absolute symlinks, not through install_config.sh
The governed unattended launcher is struck; only a convenience wrapper survives
Auto mode is off, and allow deliberately carries both the broad and the narrow shape

out_of_scope: Re-running any U1-U7 experiment - all seven are resolved with evidence in the findings doc, and re-running them costs hours and risks tripping the security flags that already fired twice
Pruning the 58 refs left under refs/checkpoint-experiment/ - deleting refs is trivial but reclaiming the roughly 9 MB needs gc --prune, which is guarded under D2 and is a human act
